scope: Complete explicitly named source-voice settings; no recollected notes, omitted cadences, theme excerpts, inferred stanza loops, or highest-note arrangements.

encoding.sourceEvents: [sounding MIDI or full chord MIDI array or null, startQuarter, nominal durationQuarter], aligned with sourceKinds/sourceTokens. Grace entries have zero nominal score duration, not zero-length playback notes.
encoding.performedScalarEvents: [scalar sounding MIDI,startQuarter,durationQuarter,1-based sourceEventIndex]. All chord pitches retained in source order; stable start sort. Convert quarters to ms using scheduleQuarterBpm. No velocity invented.
encoding.exactOfficialMidiScalarTicks: Amazing Grace only: [midi,startTick,durationTicks,sourceEventIndex]; PPQ=384. Canonical exact export times retain 1-tick rounding gaps. Positive playback durations are derived from these ticks.
encoding.formAst: eventIndex is zero-based into sourceEvents. repeat/alternative structure is parsed from exact source, then expanded with correct alternative choice. Resolved source pitches are replayed, not recalculated at repeat jumps.
encoding.ties: No selected-source ties. Parentheses and beam brackets are slurs/beams; untied repeated pitches remain separate attacks.
encoding.silences: Printed rests remain explicit and are not fabricated scalar MIDI notes.

selectionNotes: Preferred examples Happy Birthday/Frere Jacques/Jingle Bells did not yield a verified simple Mutopia digital edition during this bounded search. Selected recognizable complete folk/nursery settings instead.
Au Clair de la Lune, Oats and Beans have no pickup or meter ambiguity; Soldier's Joy has explicit pickup and MIDI-confirmed default meter; Auld and Amazing Grace limitations are explicit.
Amazing Grace is an open-license arranged edition, not a public-domain edition. No blanket all-public-domain-edition assertion.
